findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: doctor_get_company_info · Private data: doctor_search_site · Public sink: doctor_supplement_facts, doctor_get_company_info.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: doctor_get_company_info · Private data: doctor_search_site · Public sink: doctor_supplement_facts, doctor_get_company_info

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "doctor_supplement_facts" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
